text: From the S4.3a review: the query and reference panels must share one Covering extent (Gaze extent is data-dependent). Parity: placement numerals in Plex Mono, the 'Remembered image not shown' caption, the '1024×768 in 1920×1080' caption, outside marks not reduced to dots, and the fixation cross token on light stage. S4.3a also loses typed StimulusError at the boundary, never retries failed loads and has an unbounded decoded-raster cache; fix these in S4.4 or S8.2.
